name: Lighting Virginia
old_description: Lighting Virginia is a statewide agency that provides innovative lighting solutions. We enthusiastically represent the finest manufacturers of quality lighting products. Our combined experience of more than three centuries enables us to work closely with specifiers and contractors – from the early concept stages of a project through the project’s completion. Lighting Virginia is committed to supporting our customers with a high level of energy and integrity.
about:
Lighting Virginia operates as a statewide lighting agency headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia. The firm represents a curated roster of lighting manufacturers and serves specifiers and contractors across the commonwealth. While its founding year is not publicly disclosed, the agency notes that its team brings a combined experience of more than three centuries to each project.

The agency does not manufacture products itself; instead, it acts as a manufacturer’s representative, connecting architects, engineers, and contractors with lighting lines suited to commercial, institutional, and residential projects. Its services span product specification, lighting design assistance, value engineering, and project management from concept through installation. The firm maintains showrooms in Roanoke, Richmond, and Virginia Beach, offering physical and virtual access to product lines from brands such as Modern Forms, Alora, Kuzco, and MP Lighting.

Lighting Virginia’s client base consists primarily of architecture and design firms, electrical contractors, and facility owners throughout Virginia. The agency has collaborated on projects with firms including Baskervill, Glave & Holmes Architecture, Commonwealth Architects, and HKS, Inc., providing lighting specifications for educational, healthcare, hospitality, and civic buildings.

The agency emphasizes a consultative approach, positioning itself as a design partner rather than a product reseller. Leadership stresses long-term relationships and a deep understanding of design intent, aiming to elevate projects through thoughtful lighting solutions rather than simply supplying fixtures.
